name: Zalando Partner (ZDS)
description: Zalando's zDirect partner APIs for Partner Fulfilment (Direct Ship) merchants: orders, order items, order shipments and announced returns. OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Partner onboarding required.
instructions:
**Partner onboarding required.** Zalando's merchant APIs are not open: you need an active Zalando Partner Programme contract and credentials issued through **Zalando zDirect**. There is no self-service signup. Zalando runs a sandbox at `https://api-sandbox.merchants.zalando.com`, but it too is only reachable with zDirect credentials.

**Setup**
1. In the zDirect Portal open **Applications**, create or pick an app and copy its **client id** and **client secret** (under *Credentials*). Give the app the `orders/read` scope.
2. Note your **merchant id** — a UUID that scopes every path. Zalando merchants often have several (one per sales channel or country), and the wrong one returns an empty, entirely convincing result.
3. Set `ZALANDO_CLIENT_ID`, `ZALANDO_CLIENT_SECRET` and `ZALANDO_MERCHANT_ID`.

**Client credentials, scoped per API.** The adapter calls the production API at `https://api.merchants.zalando.com` and gets its token from `https://api.merchants.zalando.com/auth/token` (client id and secret as HTTP Basic). The scopes granted to your app determine which paths answer: a 403 usually means a missing scope rather than a bad secret.

**Read-only, orders only.** Zalando's Stocks and Prices APIs are write-only (there is no endpoint to read back stock or prices), so this adapter does not offer them. Shipments exist per order: call `zalando_zds_list_shipments` with an order id.

**Responses are JSON:API** (`application/vnd.api+json`): rows under `data`, related records under `included` when you ask for them with `include`.

**Paging differs per endpoint.** Orders are paged by number: `page_size` (1-1000, default 50) and a zero-based `page_number`. Announced returns are cursor-paged: pass back the `cursor` from the previous response's `next` link.

**Dates** are ISO 8601, e.g. `2026-09-01T00:00:00Z`. The order date filters are exclusive.

**Unverified against a live account.** Paths and parameter names follow Zalando's published OpenAPI specifications and the production host answers on them, but no tool has been run with real credentials. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_orders
tools.description: List orders for the merchant with their order number, date, status and totals. Paged by number: page_size (1-1000) and a zero-based page_number. Default sort is -modified_at (latest first).

created_after.description: Orders created after this ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive), e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z.

created_before.description: Orders created before this ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive).

last_updated_after.description: Orders modified after this ISO 8601 timestamp (exclusive).

order_number.description: Find one order by its Zalando order number.

exported.description: true for orders already exported, false for not yet exported ones.

sort.description: Sort attribute, prefix with - for descending, e.g. -order_date. Default -modified_at.

tools.name: zalando_zds_get_order
tools.description: Read one order in full: its items with EAN and price, the delivery address, and the current fulfilment state of each item.

orderId.description: Zalando order id (UUID, the `id` from zalando_zds_list_orders), not the order number.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_order_items
tools.description: List the individual items of one order with their EAN, article number, price and per-item status — the level Zalando actually fulfils and cancels at.

orderId.description: Zalando order id (UUID, the `id` from zalando_zds_list_orders), not the order number.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_shipments
tools.description: List the shipments of one order, with their carrier, tracking number and the order items they cover. Zalando exposes shipments per order only; every order has at least one.

tools.name: zalando_zds_list_returns
tools.description: List announced returns (a customer created a return label for a Partner Fulfilled order) with their items, reason and the order they belong to. Cursor-paged.

after.description: Returns created at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

before.description: Returns created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

cursor.description: Cursor taken from the previous response's next link.
